user_story: As a user, I want to filter tasks by completion status so that I can see only open or only done tasks.

positive.title: Filter tasks to show only open tasks
steps: Navigate to the task list page.
Select the filter option for 'Open' tasks.
positive.expected_result: Only tasks with the status 'Open' are displayed.

negative.title: Attempt to filter tasks without selecting a status
steps: Navigate to the task list page.
Open the filter menu but do not select any status.
negative.expected_result: The filter does not apply and possibly shows an error message indicating that a selection is necessary.

edge.title: Filter tasks with an empty task list
steps: Ensure the task list is cleared, leaving no tasks.
Navigate to the task list page.
Select the filter option for 'Done' tasks.
edge.expected_result: The system should display a message indicating no 'Done' tasks are available, without errors.
